## Question and hypothesis

What uncertainty does this experiment resolve?

## What to build

Describe one observable end-to-end path using synthetic data.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expected observations and required platform coverage specified.
- [ ] Evidence attached for the tested commit, with failures and limitations included.
- [ ] LikeC4 updated and generated, or no-impact rationale recorded.
- [ ] Retain/rework/discard recommendation recorded.

## Exclusions

What is deliberately outside the experiment?

## Blocked by

None, or issue references.

## Budget and stopping conditions

Three correction attempts or 90 minutes of active agent work per run, whichever comes first. Preserve budget across restarts. Stop for unresolved product decisions; do not weaken gates. See the development workflow.
